page.subtitle: The site's terminology for a language pair — the rules the two-model translation enforces before a text is accepted.

rule.preferHelp: When the term appears in the source, the translation must use this rendering.
rule.doNotTranslateHelp: The term keeps its source spelling in the translation; the translation equals the term.
rule.forbiddenHelp: This wording must never appear in the target text, whatever the source says.
